sections.Profile:
"Sweet Sioux" is a four-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in September 1959. Designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker, the game features two flippers, three pop bumpers, two slingshots, two gobble holes, two bullseye targets, two standup targets, and a roto-target.
